title: 有馬記念の後に・涙の先へ、いつか

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara happily talks about how she heard the cheers from the stands during her race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she wholeheartedly insists that she had fun today… tears begin to trickle down her cheeks, and she cries out of frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing how hard she's taking this loss, I realize how seriously she took this race… and how much she's grown since the days when she ran carefree.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara's Arima Kinen journey comes to a close. She successfully reached her dream race… and for that, she should be very proud.
